fields.instruction_en: Enter the woman's full name as on Aadhaar. PMUY provides free LPG connection (deposit-free) to women from BPL households. Applicant must be a woman aged 18 or above.
fields.instruction_hi: Mahila ka poora naam Aadhaar ke anusar likhein. PMUY BPL parivaron ki mahilaon ko muft LPG connection (deposit-free) deti hai. Avedan karne wali mahila ki aayu 18 saal ya adhik honi chahiye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your age. You must be 18 years or older. PMUY is for women from SC/ST households, PMAY beneficiaries, AAY, forest dwellers, Most Backward Classes, tea garden workers etc.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni aayu likhein. 18 saal ya adhik hona zaruri hai. PMUY SC/ST parivaron ki mahilaon, PMAY labhaarthiyon, AAY, jungle mein rehne walon, Ati Pichhde Vargon, chai bagaan workers aadi ke liye hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your BPL (Below Poverty Line) ration card number. This establishes eligibility for PMUY. Households in SECC-2011 database are also eligible.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna BPL (Garibi Rekha se Neeche) ration card number likhein. Isse PMUY ke liye paatrata siddh hoti hai. SECC-2011 database mein shaamil parivaar bhi paatra hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your complete residential address where the LPG connection will be installed. The gas agency will verify this address before releasing the connection.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna poora awasiya pata likhein jahan LPG connection lagaya jaayega. Gas agency connection jaari karne se pehle yeh pata verify karegi.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your bank account number. PMUY provides interest-free loan for first refill and hot plate. Subsidy on LPG cylinders is transferred directly to this account via PAHAL scheme.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna bank khata number likhein. PMUY pehli refill aur hot plate ke liye byaj-mukt loan deti hai. LPG cylinders par subsidy PAHAL yojana se seedhe isi khate mein transfer hoti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar. Must be linked to bank account for LPG subsidy transfer under PAHAL (DBTL) scheme.
fields.instruction_hi: 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein. PAHAL (DBTL) yojana ke tahat LPG subsidy transfer ke liye bank account se linked hona chahiye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 10-digit mobile number for LPG booking and cylinder delivery updates.
fields.instruction_hi: LPG booking aur cylinder delivery updates ke liye apna 10 ank ka mobile number likhein.
